eligibility: Only outputs without three confident agreeing votes in the frozen five-judge pass
independent_review: Same credential definition; high reasoning; no original votes, origin, run IDs, baseline labels or target rate
decision: Accept matching best binary decisions from both reviewers, retaining confidence and reasons. If they disagree or a review fails, require an explicit evidence-based final adjudication; never silently default to zero.
scope: Do not change any output that already meets the original consensus rule. Keep initial consensus and the separate adjudication records.
